verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents OpenAI-compatible endpoints (base URL/key/model swap, 'two code changes') plus SDKs, streaming, tool-calling and structured outputs, which is the generic mechanism agent frameworks use to plug in, and community reports confirm official Cursor support and an llm-cerebras CLI plugin. However, the evidence pack lacks first-party, named integration guides for specific coding agents or agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Cursor, Aider) beyond generic OpenAI-compat docs, and one community comment notes earlier framework integrations were 'patchy at best' before official support existed. Missing for 10: dedicated first-party docs/pages for popular agent frameworks or coding agents, and stronger independent corroboration that these integrations work smoothly today.
